title: eryngium aquifolium subsp. caespitiferum

This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Eryngium aquifolium subsp. caespitiferum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpene lactones and alkaloids. While its bioactive constituents are not fully studied, they are believed to contribute to its reported health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
